# Camp Ally: Leo Petrov

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 23, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Jan 19, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3bdda62506d942bea5bf1d64199408ba~mv2.png)

Image Credit: __Bethesda Fanatic__

#### **Type**

Lite Ally

Lite Allies do not offer a daily/repeatable quest, they are most often vendors and offer buffs in return for you letting them sleep at your camp.

#### **Specialises in**

Nuka Cola Products.

#### **Faction**

N/A

#### **Lore**

Leo's background can be found __here__. 

**Health Bar (HP)** 

534 HP

#### **Camp Item**

Leo's Desk

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_034e5b6b4ee545b381226693d4317e0e~mv2.jpg)

#### **Flamingo Units**

2x Flamingo Units

Flamingo Unit camp item cost __spreadsheet__ 

#### **Obtainable from**

- Season 11 scoreboard - Nuka World on Tour (free)
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation once you have reached Ally status with the Settlers (4000 Gold Bullion)

**Daily Quest**

N/A

**Buffs/Services**

24-hour cool down period on all buffs and services excluding the Well Rested/Lover's Embrace buff.

Well Rested - +5% XP for 3 hours

Nuka-Inspiration - Speak to Leo (I'm in need of your services/You mentioned you needed a Nuka-Cola?) and give him one of the Nuka Cola products from the below list and he will apply the drink's buff to your character for an hour.

These buffs do not stack on top of each other.

These buffs are not affected by the Cola-Nut perk card.

The Nuka-Cola Cranberry XP buff stacks with the Well Rested perk and Steven Scarberry's XP buff.

| NukaShine | 25% AP Regen | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Grape | 30 Action Points | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Wild | 2 Perception | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Vaccinated | 20 Disease Resistance | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Scorched | 20 Disease Resistance | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola My Blood's in it | 20 Disease Resistance | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Twist | 2 Luck | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Quantum | 50 HP | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Orange | 50 Rad Resistance | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Dark | 25 Sneak Points | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola Cranberry | 5% XP | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cola | 2 Charisma | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cherry | 2 Endurance | 60 mins | 
| Nuka-Cherry | +10 Damage Resistance | 60 mins |
